description: This file implements a SelectorEvaluator class for evaluating CSS selectors and related utilities within a web automation context, including caching, engine management, and DOM traversal functions.

classes.name: SelectorEvaluatorImpl
classes.description: Implements the SelectorEvaluator interface, managing selector matching, querying, caching, and engine handling.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines if an element matches a given selector within a specific context.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Finds all elements matching a selector within a given context.

methods.name: _cached
methods.description: Caches results of selector operations to optimize repeated queries.

methods.name: _checkSelector
methods.description: Validates and casts a selector to the expected type.

methods.name: _hasScopeClause
methods.description: Checks if a selector includes a scope clause.

methods.name: _expandContextForScopeMatching
methods.description: Expands the query context to include scope matching via parent or shadow host.

methods.name: _matchesSimple
methods.description: Checks if an element matches a simple selector.

methods.name: _querySimple
methods.description: Performs a simple query based on a simple selector.

methods.name: _matchesParents
methods.description: Checks if an element matches the parent chain of a complex selector.

methods.name: _matchesEngine
methods.description: Executes a selector engine's match logic.

methods.name: _queryEngine
methods.description: Executes a selector engine's query logic.

methods.name: _callMatches
methods.description: Calls a selector engine's matches method with caching.

methods.name: _callQuery
methods.description: Calls a selector engine's query method with caching.

methods.name: _matchesCSS
methods.description: Checks if an element matches a CSS selector string.

methods.name: _queryCSS
methods.description: Performs a CSS selector query with caching, including shadow DOM piercing if enabled.

methods.name: _getEngine
methods.description: Retrieves a selector engine by name, throws if unknown.
